PanePilot {version}

Two-panel file manager modelled on FreeCommander.

Settings and favorites are stored in:
{config}

Built with Python and Qt (PySide6).
action.extract_subfolder_many: Extract each into its own folder
dialog.compress_what: Pack {what}. The archive is created in the folder {folder}.
archive.link_dir_skipped: Link to a folder – not possible in a ZIP archive, skipped

archive.tool_failed: The archiver stopped with error code {code}
toolbar.title: Toolbar
filter.invert: Hide matches instead of showing them
filter.hint_wildcard: * = any characters, ? = one character, separate several patterns with ; (e.g. *.pdf;*.docx). Without wildcards, part of the name is enough. With “Hide folders” the pattern may stay empty.
favsets.delete_confirm: Delete favorites set “{name}” with {n} entries (top level)?
favsets.error_chars: “{name}” contains characters that are not allowed in file names (e.g. / \ : * ? " < > |) or starts with a dot.
favorites.no_sidebar: No favorites sidebar is open in the active panel. Please first open the favorites sidebar in the desired panel (Alt+F) and choose the favorites set.
fkeys.gnome_reserved: Used by GNOME – not usable from the keyboard, but works with a mouse click while holding Alt.
rename.title: Multi-rename
rename.profile_overwrite: A profile “{name}” already exists. Overwrite it?
rename.date_hint: JJJJ/JJ = year, MM = month, TT = day, hh = hour, mm = minute, ss = second
rename.summary_conflicts: {n} conflict(s) – please check the lines marked in red.
rename.err_empty: The new name is empty or invalid.
rename.err_chars: The new name contains a forbidden character (/).
rename.err_exists_now: Target name is now taken – not renamed
rename.errors_intro: The following items could not be renamed:

settings.title: Settings
settings.lang_restart_hint: A new language takes effect after restarting PanePilot. ✎ = your own language file.
settings.prof_hint: Set the order and width of the columns directly in the panel (drag the column header) – the active profile remembers it automatically.
settings.backup_hint: A backup is made automatically at the first start of each day. Backups made by hand are never deleted.
settings.lang_changed: The new language takes effect after a restart. Restart now?
backup.unreachable: Backup not possible: {folder} is not reachable (share not mounted?).
backup.done:
The settings have been backed up:
{path}
backup.restore_confirm: Restore the settings from “{name}”? The current state is backed up first, then PanePilot restarts.

lang.err_exists: A language with the code “{code}” already exists.
lang.tip_missing: Missing – the fallback language is shown.
lang.tip_placeholder: The placeholders in {curly braces} must be the same as in the template.
lang.edit_hint: Saved as your own language file in the settings folder (Sprachen/). Changes take effect after a restart.

props.meta_coming: The metadata editor follows in version 0.9.

search.title: Search
search.text_hint: Searches text files and – with the checkbox – PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and LibreOffice (not DOC, XLS, PPT; scanned PDFs without text are not found). Files over 100 MB are skipped and listed after the search. Searching documents takes longer.
search.err_empty: Please enter a file name or a text.
search.skipped: {n} large file(s) over 100 MB were skipped in the text search (hover here for the list).
checksum.title: Checksums
checksum.no_file: Please select a file (folders have no checksum).
checksum.unknown_format: Not a known checksum format (expected: 8, 32, 40, 64 or 128 hex characters).
search.network_hint: Network shares can slow the search down considerably.
backup.import_failed: The file is not a valid PanePilot backup or could not be copied: {reason}
meta.title: Meta Wizard
meta.field.title: Title
meta.read_errors: {n} file(s) could not be read (marked red).
meta.loaded: {n} files read. Select files to edit them.
meta.none_found: No music files, pictures or videos found.
meta.save_errors: The following files could not be saved (the changes remain marked):
meta.unsaved: {n} file(s) have unsaved changes. Save now?
meta.wav_hint: Note: many players ignore tags in WAV files.
meta.cover_hint: Right-click the picture to replace, remove or save the cover. You can also drag a picture here.
conv.no_match: The file name does not match the pattern.
conv.marked: {n} track(s) marked red and not changed (reason: hover over the row).
fields.title: Edit tag fields
fields.intro: Here you only change the structure of the tags of all {n} tracks in the list: delete, rename or add fields. Edit the contents in the sidebar.
fields.delete_tip: Delete the field and its contents from all files
fields.hint: New fields stay empty until you enter a value in the sidebar – only then are they written to the files. Changes are written with “Save tags”.
fields.tip_standard: Standard field – cannot be deleted or renamed.
fields.tip_known: Known field with a fixed name – can be deleted but not renamed.
fields.tip_fixed: Field with a fixed name – can only be deleted.
fields.tip_data: Data field without readable contents – can only be deleted.
fields.err_name: “{name}” is not a valid field name. Letters, digits, spaces, “_” and “-” are allowed.
fields.err_known: “{name}” is the name of a known field. Use “Tag → tag” to move contents.
textimp.hint: Files on the left, lines on the right – entries side by side belong together. Move them with “Move up”/“Move down”, fill gaps with “Insert placeholder”. Empty cells leave a field unchanged, “<remove>” deletes it.
textimp.preview_skip: There is a placeholder opposite – nothing is taken over here.
textimp.done: {n} track(s) taken from the text file.
number.title: Numbering wizard
number.intro: Track numbers for {n} tracks are assigned top to bottom in the order of the list.
playlist.title: Create playlist
playlist.intro: Create a playlist with {n} tracks under this name:
playlist.hint_relative: Tracks are listed relative to the playlist's location – it also works if the NAS is mounted elsewhere (e.g. on Windows).
playlist.hint_absolute: Tracks are listed with their full Linux path – the playlist will not work on Windows.
checksum.file_no_entry: “{name}” contains no checksum for the selected file.
toolbar.spacer_width: Width of the gap (also changes the selected gap)
rg.needs_ffmpeg: Requires the “ffmpeg” package (sudo apt install ffmpeg). More in the help under “Additional programs”.
rg.intro: The loudness of {n} tracks will be measured ({albums} albums by album tag). Target loudness: {target} LUFS (can be changed in the settings). The music itself is not changed – only tags are written.
rg.hint: Without the check mark only missing values are added. For the album value all tracks with the same album tag are measured. Measuring takes about 1–3 seconds per track.
rg.done: ReplayGain: {n} tracks measured, {changed} with new values (green) – write them with “Save tags”.
rg.nothing: All tracks already have ReplayGain values. Tick “Overwrite existing values” to recalculate.
rg.errors: The following files could not be measured:
settings.rg_hint: −18 LUFS is the ReplayGain standard. Other values do not match what foobar2000 and most players expect.
settings.display_hint: These switches are also in the “View” menu. They take effect after “OK”.

The changes apply after a restart.

donate.text:
PanePilot is free of charge and free software.

If you like PanePilot and want to support its development, I'd be happy about a coffee via Ko-fi.

As a thank-you you get a personal supporter code, and this note no longer appears.

donate.thanks: Thank you very much for your support, {name}! The note will no longer appear.

settings.update_hint: PanePilot asks GitHub for the latest version. Only the usual identifier “PanePilot/version” is sent, no personal data. You can also check by hand at any time via Help ▸ Check for updates ….
update.title: Updates
update.hint_appimage: “Download” saves the new version next to the current AppImage file. The old file is kept.
update.hint_page: PanePilot is not running as an AppImage (or its folder is read-only). You can download the new version from the release page.
update.none: You already have the latest version ({version}).
update.restart: {name} has been downloaded. Quit PanePilot now and start the new version?
disc.title: Assign disc numbers
disc.intro: Disc numbers for {n} tracks (the selected or all displayed ones, in the displayed order):
disc.mode_folder: By subfolder: each folder is one disc (e.g. CD1, CD2)
disc.mode_restart: New disc whenever the track number starts again
disc.mode_manual: Manually: all tracks get the same number
disc.hint_field: Note: most MP3 players only read the total in the form “1/2”. The separate DISCTOTAL field is mainly common for FLAC/Ogg.
mb.title: MusicBrainz
mb.search_intro: Search for the album on MusicBrainz ({n} tracks). The entries come from the tags; you can change them.
mb.results_info: {n} results. Marked green: same number of tracks as files ({files}). Click a column header to sort.
mb.no_results: Nothing found. Use “< Back” to change the search.
mb.legend: Double-click or “Next >” takes the selected entry.
mb.tracks_match: Number of tracks matches the files
mb.track_fields: Track fields (values of the selected track)
mb.assign_hint: Entries side by side belong together. Yellow: the length differs by more than 5 seconds. Only checked fields are applied; double-click a value to change it. Nothing is written until you click “Save tags”.
mb.length_differs: The length differs by more than 5 seconds
mb.done: MusicBrainz data marked for {n} tracks (green). Click “Save tags” to write them.
settings.import_filezilla_hint: Takes over FileZilla’s server list (~/.config/filezilla/sitemanager.xml) including saved passwords. Existing servers with the same name are skipped.

srv.passphrase_hint: Passphrase of the key file (if needed)
srv.no_keyring: No keyring found – the password is asked for when connecting and not saved.
srv.local_dir: Local folder in the other panel:
srv.transfer_hint: Only applies to FTP. In active mode the server opens the data connection; this often fails behind a router.
srv.charset_intro: The server uses the following character set for file names:
srv.charset_auto: Automatic (UTF-8 if the server supports it)
srv.charset_hint: A wrong character set leads to garbled file names. Only applies to FTP.
srv.passphrase_for: Passphrase of the key file for “{name}” ({file}):

srv.no_sftp: The SSH server does not offer SFTP. PanePilot does not support plain SCP.
srv.no_host: No host is set for “{name}”. Please add it in the server manager.
srv.lost: The connection to “{name}” was lost ({reason}). Reconnect?
srv.not_connected: There is no connection to {uri}. Please connect via the “Servers” sidebar.
srv.not_on_server: This is not possible on a server.
srv.no_server_to_server: Copying directly from server to server is not possible. Please copy to a local folder first.
srv.delete_files_confirm: Permanently delete {what} on the server? There is no trash on the server.
srv.quit_transfers: Transfers are still running. Quit anyway? The current file will be aborted.
srv.import_info: {n} servers found. Checked servers are taken over:
srv.import_hint: Saved passwords go to the keyring. Servers that already exist (same name in the same folder) are skipped.
srv.import_no_keyring: No keyring found – passwords are not taken over but asked for when connecting.
srv.import_missing:
No FileZilla server list was found:
{path}
srv.import_failed: The FileZilla server list could not be read: {reason}
srv.import_empty: The FileZilla server list is empty.
srv.import_no_keyring_count: {n} passwords could not be saved in the keyring and will be asked for when connecting.
transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.not_a_folder: A file with the folder’s name exists at the target.
meta.field.author: Author
photo.heic_hint: PanePilot can only edit HEIC photos with the exiftool program – without it the fields are read-only. Install with: sudo apt install libimage-exiftool-perl
photo.switch_discard: There are unsaved changes. They will be lost when switching. Switch anyway?
shift.title: Shift date taken
shift.hint: Shifts the date taken of the photos or videos by the given time – for example if the camera clock was wrong or still set to home time after a trip. Example: the camera was one hour slow → “+ 1 hour”. The file’s modification date stays unchanged. The new values are first marked green and only written with “Save tag”.
shift.done: Date taken marked for {n} files (green). Click “Save tag” to write.
video.frame_info: Still frame from the video – the video has no thumbnail of its own.
video.ffmpeg_hint: PanePilot needs the ffmpeg program for duration, resolution, codecs, date taken and GPS. Install with: sudo apt install ffmpeg
video.mkv_hint: PanePilot can only edit MKV and WebM videos with the mkvtoolnix programs – without them the fields are read-only. Install with: sudo apt install mkvtoolnix
video.exiftool_hint: The date taken and GPS of MP4/MOV videos can only be changed or removed with the exiftool program. Install with: sudo apt install libimage-exiftool-perl
video.readonly_hint: AVI and MTS videos are read-only.
video.wmv_hint: The date taken of WMV videos cannot be changed.
shift.locked_count: {n} cannot be changed (see the note in the sidebar).
video.wrong_ext: “{name}” is actually a {real} file – the extension does not match the content. PanePilot still reads it correctly; the matching extension would be cleaner.
video.wrong_ext_many: {n} files have an extension that does not match the content (see the “Format” column). PanePilot still reads them correctly.
dup.title: Find duplicates
dup.other: Also search the folder of the other panel ({path})
dup.mode_name: b) Same name without extension (e.g. Film.mkv and Film.mp4)
dup.mode_namesize: c) Same name and same size (fast, no checksum)
dup.speed_hint: b) to e) are fast because only names and sizes are compared (e is somewhat slower with very many files). a) is the most accurate but has to read files of the same size completely – with large files or over the network (NAS) this can take a long time. For e), extension, case, punctuation and IDs like [imdbid-…] do not count; numbers in the name must match. f) compares images or videos by picture content (not rotated or mirrored); videos take 1–3 seconds per file, the next run is fast thanks to remembered fingerprints.
dup.trash_confirm: Move {n} checked files ({size}) to the trash?
dup.trash_all_warning: Warning: in {n} groups all files are checked – none of them would remain!
dup.mode_id: d) Same ID in the name (e.g. [imdbid-tt0078748])
meta.field.subject: Subject
doc.signed_hint: Digitally signed PDFs are read-only: any change would invalidate the signature.
doc.ole_hint: Old Office files (DOC, XLS, PPT) are read-only.
online.title: Online data
online.no_id: no ID and no title in the file name
online.bad_key: The TMDB API key was rejected. Please check it in the settings (Meta wizard → Online data for movies).
online.choose_intro: There are several matches for “{name}”. Which movie is it?
online.review_intro: {n} of {total} movies found (source: {source}). Only fields that are empty so far are checked. Existing values are only overwritten if you tick them. Nothing is written until “Save tags”.
online.done: Online data marked for {n} videos – “Save tags” writes them to the files.
online.tmdb_notice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
online.wikidata_notice: Data from Wikidata (free to use, CC0). Without a TMDB key there is no plot summary and no poster.
settings.tmdb_hint: You get the key for free with an account on themoviedb.org (Settings → API). It is only stored in your keyring. Without a key PanePilot fetches the data from Wikidata, then without plot summary and poster. Instructions: Help → Meta wizard → Online data.
settings.online_language: Language of the online data: title, plot summary and genre come in the program language (currently {lang}). If there is no version in that language, English is used.
settings.tmdb_no_keyring: No keyring available: the key is only kept until PanePilot is closed.
online.series_no_key: series only with a TMDB key
tracks.title: Edit tracks
tracks.intro_one: Tracks of “{name}”. Language, name and flags can be changed; they are written directly to the file.
tracks.intro_many: Tracks of {n} videos, grouped by number. A change applies to this track in all selected videos; empty fields shown as “different” stay unchanged.
tracks.suggest_tip: Builds names like “German AC3 5.1” from language, format and channels – for the selected rows, otherwise for all audio and subtitle tracks.
tracks.hint: “Default” is the track a player picks first; “Forced” shows subtitles only for foreign-language parts. For video tracks only the name can be changed.
tracks.only_mkv: Tracks can be edited in MKV and MP4 files. None of the selected videos is one of them.
tracks.no_tool: MKV files need mkvtoolnix (mkvmerge and mkvpropedit), e.g. via “sudo apt install mkvtoolnix”.
tracks.confirm: {tracks} tracks in {files} files will be changed. This is written to the files immediately and cannot be undone with “Undo”.
tracks.skipped_other: {n} selected videos are not MKV files and are skipped.
tracks.skipped_missing: Skipped because the track is missing:
tracks.remux_note: In {n} MP4 files the track name or “Default” changes. PanePilot repacks them for this (no re-encoding, no quality loss). This takes about as long as copying the files ({size}) and temporarily needs as much free space. Tags, custom fields and cover are kept; the old file is only replaced after a successful check.
tracks.forced_mp4: “Forced” is hardly supported by MP4 and cannot be stored reliably here.
tracks.cancelled: Cancelled – the remaining files are unchanged.
tracks.remove_tip: Remove the track – a new file “…-Copy” is created, the original stays unchanged.
tracks.last_audio: The last audio track is kept.
tracks.export_tip: Saves the selected subtitles (without selection: all) as files next to the video, e.g. “Film.eng.srt” – without removing them.
tracks.export_before: Save subtitles as files before removing
tracks.remove_note: Tracks are removed in {n} videos. For each, a new file “…-Copy” is created in the same folder; the originals stay unchanged. This takes about as long as copying ({size}) and needs as much free space.
tracks.export_note: First, {n} subtitles are saved as files next to the video.
remux.check_failed: The new file is incomplete (tracks or length do not match) and was discarded.
remux.image_subs_mp4: Image subtitles cannot be exported from MP4.
remux.no_video_removal: The video track cannot be removed.
remux.last_audio: The last audio track cannot be removed.
convert.title: Change format
convert.intro: The selected videos are repacked into another format without re-encoding (no quality loss). A new file is created in the same folder; the originals stay unchanged. Tags, custom fields, cover, tracks and chapters are taken over.
convert.note: MP4 cannot hold image subtitles (PGS, VobSub) or audio formats such as DTS or TrueHD – such files are skipped. Text subtitles are converted for MP4 (formatting is lost).
convert.image_subs: contains image subtitles (PGS/VobSub) that MP4 cannot hold
convert.audio_codec: audio format {codec} does not fit into MP4
convert.confirm: {n} videos will be converted ({size}). This takes about as long as copying and needs as much free space. The originals stay unchanged.
convert.done: {n} videos converted – the new files are now also in the list.
tracks.replace_tip: When removing tracks, the new file is checked first and then replaces the original. Without the tick a new file “…-Copy” is created.
tracks.remove_note_replace: Tracks are removed in {n} videos and the originals replaced – this cannot be undone. The new file is checked first; on an error or cancel the original stays. This takes about as long as copying ({size}) and temporarily needs as much free space.
convert.replace: Delete original afterwards (keep only the new file)
convert.replace_tip: The original is only deleted once the new file is finished and checked.
convert.replace_warning: The originals are deleted after a successful conversion and cannot be restored.
online.manual_intro: Search the film for “{name}”: adjust title and year or enter an ID (IMDb “tt…” or TMDb number).
online.manual_intro_series: Search the series for “{name}” – applies to all episodes of this series. Adjust title and year or enter an ID (IMDb “tt…” or TMDb number).
settings.os_languages_tip: Language codes separated by commas, e.g. “de, en” (order = order in the result list).
settings.os_hint: To search and download subtitles you need a free account at opensubtitles.com and your own API key under “API Consumers”. Without login 5 downloads per day are possible, more with username and password. Key and password are only stored in the keyring.
subs.title: Search subtitles
subs.no_key: Searching subtitles needs an OpenSubtitles API key. Enter it under Settings → “Subtitles (OpenSubtitles)”.
subs.bad_login: OpenSubtitles rejected the access – please check API key, username and password.
subs.intro: Subtitles were found for {n} of {total} videos. The best hit per language is preselected; “exact match” means: uploaded for exactly this file.
subs.remaining_unknown: Logged in – OpenSubtitles reports the remaining downloads when downloading.
subs.anonymous: Without login 5 downloads per day are possible.
subs.direct_tip: The downloaded subtitles are also added as a track to the video (MKV and MP4 only) – as a new file “…-Copy” or, with “Replace original”, into the original file.
subs.note: Files are saved next to the video, e.g. “Film.eng.srt”, “Film.eng.forced.srt”, “Film.eng.sdh.srt” – Jellyfin finds them too. Each download counts against your daily quota.
subs.quota: The daily download quota is used up (available again in {reset}).
tracks.add_subs_tip: Add subtitle files (SRT, ASS, SUP …) to the video as new tracks.
tracks.add_subs_one: Subtitles can only be added to a single video.
tracks.add_note: {n} subtitle files are added as new tracks; the files themselves stay where they are.
tracks.rebuild_note: {n} videos are rewritten (removing tracks or adding subtitles). For each, a new file “…-Copy” is created in the same folder; the originals stay unchanged. This takes about as long as copying ({size}) and needs as much free space.
tracks.rebuild_note_replace: {n} videos are rewritten (removing tracks or adding subtitles) and the originals replaced – this cannot be undone. The new file is checked first; on an error or cancel the original stays. This takes about as long as copying ({size}) and temporarily needs as much free space.
remux.image_subs_add: Image subtitles (SUP, VobSub) only fit into MKV.
addsubs.title: Add subtitles
addsubs.intro: These subtitle files are added as new tracks to “{name}”. Matching files from the folder are already listed; language, name and “Forced” can be adjusted.
addsubs.none: There is no matching subtitle file in the folder – choose one with “Other file …”.
addsubs.mp4_note: MP4: text subtitles are converted (formatting is lost); image subtitles (SUP, VobSub) only fit into MKV.
chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.no_videos: Please select MKV or MP4 videos first.
chapters.intro_one: Chapters of the video (length {length}). Times and names can be edited directly in the table.
chapters.intro_many: {n} videos selected: create chapters at a fixed interval or delete all chapters. Editing and reading from a file only work for a single video.
chapters.warn_beyond: {n} chapters were after the end of the film ({length}) and were left out – the file probably belongs to a different version.
chapters.warn_length: The chapter file ends at {file}, the film runs {length} – it probably belongs to a different version. Please check the times.
chapters.bad_time: Row {n}: the time is invalid (example: 00:12:30 or 01:02:03.500).
chapters.after_end: At least one chapter is after the end of the film ({length}). Please adjust the times.
chapters.replace_tip: MP4 chapters can only be changed by rewriting the file. With the tick the original is replaced (after a successful check), otherwise “…-Copy” is created.
chapters.note_mkv: MKV: chapters are saved directly in the file (fast, no copy).
chapters.note_mp4: MKV: directly in the file. MP4: the file is rewritten – as “…-Copy” or, with the tick, replacing the original; this takes about as long as copying.
tracks.header_toggle: Click: tick all – click again: untick all
sync.title: Synchronize folders
sync.local_only: Comparing folders only works when both windows show a local folder (or a mounted share) – not servers, the trash or search results.
sync.same_folder: Both windows show the same folder.
sync.quick_result: Folders compared: {left} differing files marked on the left, {right} on the right.
sync.profile_delete_q: Delete the saved synchronization “{name}”? The folders themselves stay unchanged.
sync.mirror: Mirror: target becomes exactly like the source
sync.mirror_tip: Afterwards both sides are identical: what only exists in the target goes to the trash, and newer files in the target are overwritten. Without the tick they stay untouched.
sync.dst_tip: Some drives (FAT, NAS) store times without a time zone; after a clock change they then differ by exactly one hour.
sync.content_tip: Files with the same size and date are compared byte by byte.
sync.status_conflict: Conflict: same date but different content or size – please decide yourself
sync.summary: {diff} differences · to the right: {right} · to the left: {left} · delete: {delete} · conflicts: {conflict} · to copy: {size}
sync.command_tip: Runs in the background without a terminal. The script gets PANEPILOT_LEFT, PANEPILOT_RIGHT, PANEPILOT_RESULT (ok/errors), PANEPILOT_COPIED, PANEPILOT_DELETED, PANEPILOT_FAILED and PANEPILOT_PROFILE.
sync.nested: The two folders are the same or inside each other – they cannot be synchronized.
sync.confirm:
Synchronize now?

To the right: {right} · to the left: {left} · to copy: {size}
sync.done: Done: {copied} copied, {over} overwritten, {deleted} moved to the trash, {failed} errors.
sync.cancelled: Cancelled – the rest was not synchronized.
sync.script_ok: The script after finishing ran without errors.
sync.script_failed: The script after finishing reports an error (exit code {code}):
sync.countdown_suspend: The computer will suspend in {n} seconds.
sync.countdown_shutdown: The computer will shut down in {n} seconds.
ffs.replace_q: A saved synchronization “{name}” already exists. Replace it?
ffs.overwrite_q: {n} files already exist there ({names}). Replace them?
ffs.note_database: Two-way with change detection (FFS database) does not exist in PanePilot – imported as “both directions, newer wins”.
ffs.note_directions: The directions per difference could not be imported exactly – please check.
ffs.note_include_folder: Including a folder (“{item}”) is not possible in PanePilot – left out.
ffs.note_path_filter: Filter “{item}” contains a path – PanePilot filters by name only, “{name}” now applies everywhere.
ffs.note_size_time: Size and time filters do not exist in PanePilot – left out.
ffs.note_size_only: “Compare size only” does not exist in PanePilot – time and size are compared.
ffs.note_timeshift: Time shift “{value}” was not imported (PanePilot only knows “ignore 1 hour”).
ffs.note_deletion: Deleting via “{policy}” does not exist in PanePilot – items go to the trash.
ffs.note_errors_only: Command “on errors only” does not exist in PanePilot – imported as “always”.
ffs.note_pair_settings: Separate settings of individual folder pairs were not imported.
ffs.note_not_local: “{path}” is not a local folder – PanePilot only synchronizes local folders and mounted shares.
ffs.note_pairs: {n} folder pairs – one synchronization per pair.
ffs.export_dst: “Ignore 1 hour” is not in the file – add it in FreeFileSync if needed.
ffs.export_power: Suspend/shut down after the synchronization is not in the file.
settings.online_auto_empty: without overview, only fill empty fields
settings.online_auto_all: without overview, overwrite everything (including the poster)
online.auto_unchanged: {n} movie(s) found but without new values.
online.auto_hint: The values are marked green – nothing is written until “Save tags”.
update.launcher_hint: The next start from the application menu or the taskbar launches the new version.
update.hint_package: “Download” saves the new package ({kind}) in your Downloads folder and opens it with the software installer. Installing asks for your administrator password.
update.appimage_launcher:
PanePilot is now installed as a package. The application menu still has the entry of the AppImage version, which would keep starting the AppImage.

Remove this old entry?
settings.tabs_always: Always show the tab bar (also with a single tab)
settings.tabs_hint: New tab with Ctrl+T, middle-clicking a folder or double-clicking the empty tab bar; Ctrl+W closes, Ctrl+Tab switches. Locked tabs stay put – another folder then opens in a new tab.
archive.title: Archive
archive.read_only: Not possible inside an archive – archives are read-only. Extract the files first.
archive.no_copy_into: You cannot copy into an archive – archives are read-only.
archive.password_wrong: The password for “{name}” was wrong. Please try again:
archive.needs_7z_aes: This ZIP is AES-encrypted. The program 7zip must be installed for it (package “7zip”).
settings.archive_open_app: Open archives with the default application (instead of like a folder in PanePilot)
settings.archive_hint: Inside an archive you can browse, open files and copy them to the other panel (= extract). The archive itself is never changed.
settings.update_mode_daily: Once a day (at the first start)
settings.update_old: Old AppImage file after an update:
